Name: Zhuria's Dog Breeds
Author: Zhuria
Description:
[size=3]This mod includes three dog breeds/recolours:

[list]
[*][size=3]A black and white dog with slightly altered ears (based on my real dog, Zora)[/size]
[*]A fox terrier with slightly altered ears
[*]A brindle corgi (by Kompi and used with permission)
[/list][/size][size=3]
You can enable as many or as few as you like, and they will be available for adoption in game and when you make a new save.
[/size]
[u][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=3](optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for easy config [/size]setting management
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/4B7A6Ly.png[/img] ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/uWVYHkz.png[/img] ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/5DfCKxH.png[/img]

These are my original dogs from way back in 2016, now officially converted to work with Content Patcher and Stardew Valley 1.6. Enjoy![/size]
[size=1][color=#999999](now with 100% less XNB!)[/color]

[/size][size=3]Should you encounter any issues please feel free to comment or message me on Discord - my username is sepzero
